coverNote: I am interested in the PLC Integration Engineer role because it combines industrial automation, sensors, edge systems, Linux, networking, and hands-on troubleshooting. I am pursuing an M.S. in Robotics and Autonomous Systems at Arizona State University after completing a B.S. in Computer Science. My work includes physical robot control and sensor logging, Python software, Linux-based debugging, automated validation, and an upcoming factory-automation project involving sensors, actuators, state tracking, and basic PLC/control logic. I would bring strong software fundamentals, disciplined root-cause analysis, clear documentation, and an honest foundation in industrial automation that I am eager to deepen through customer deployments. I am especially motivated by Laminar's use of sensor and edge technology to improve manufacturing efficiency and sustainability.
